text: Percent coupon applies to the amount remaining after the fixed discount, not the original subtotal (ISSUE-42 requirement 2)
detail: subtotal=200, fixed=10, percent=10%. Expected 171.00 (percent applied to post-fixed 190), got 170.00. checkout/pricing.py computes percent discount from the original subtotal instead of the post-fixed total.

text: Order total never goes below 0.00 (ISSUE-42 requirement 3)
detail: subtotal=10, fixed coupon=50 (larger than subtotal). Got -40.00. The zero-floor clamp (max(total, ZERO)) present in the single-coupon version was deleted in this PR and never replaced.

text: Applying two coupons of the same kind raises ValueError (ISSUE-42 requirement 4)
detail: 5/5 adversarial tests passed (two fixed, two percent, and mixed combinations). Does not prove correctness in general, but no counterexample was found.

text: Result is independent of coupon list order (ISSUE-42 requirement 1 + PR docstring)
detail: [fixed, percent] and [percent, fixed] both return 170.00. Note: holds for the wrong reason — percent is applied to the original subtotal regardless of order, which contradicts claim-1. If claim-1 were fixed, order independence could break.

text: Existing single-coupon and no-coupon call sites still work (ISSUE-42 backward compatibility)
detail: Calling calculate_total(items, coupon_object) with the old single-coupon convention raises TypeError: 'Coupon' object is not iterable at checkout/pricing.py:54. Silent breaking change for all existing callers.
